about:
# RandomDialogRP

RandomDialogRP is a World of Warcraft roleplay addon for sending race-themed or
custom dialogue with a chosen emote.

## Features

- Detects your character's race and includes themed phrases for supported races.
- Lets you optionally choose a class for class-specific phrases, while keeping
  race-wide phrases as a fallback.
- Lets you send phrases through Say, Yell, or Whisper.
- Replaces `%s` in a phrase with your target's first name, or `friend` if you
  have no target.
- Chooses a phrase at random and avoids immediate repeats when alternatives
  exist.
- Supports custom phrases, categories, category icons, and per-phrase emotes.
- Includes searchable phrases and multi-line previews for longer text.
- Organizes phrase, category, language, and profile controls in the phrase
  manager's tabs.
- Supports named profiles for saving different phrase collections and settings.
- Includes English and Brazilian Portuguese localization.
- Provides a movable main panel and draggable minimap button.

## Opening the Addon

- Click the RandomDialogRP button around the minimap.
- Use `/rp` to show or hide the main panel.
- Use `/rp config` or `/rp edit` to open the phrase manager.

The tutorial appears on first use and after a major or minor version update.
It can also appear after a feature update, and can always be reopened with
**Settings > Tutorial**.

## Sending Dialogue

1. Select a race and optionally a class from the main panel. Choose **None** to
   use race-wide phrases only.
2. Choose Say, Yell, or Whisper as the chat channel.
3. Click a category button to send a random phrase from that category.

Dialogue is only sent when you click a quick action; the addon does not respond
automatically. Hover over an action to see the total available phrases and the
class/race breakdown for the current selection.

When both class-specific and race-wide phrases are available, the addon chooses
from the class-specific phrases 80% of the time and from the race-wide phrases
20% of the time. The phrase manager has its own race and class selectors, so
you can edit another combination without changing the main panel selection.

Whisper sends the phrase to your current player target. If a phrase contains
`%s`, the addon's target name is inserted; without a target, it uses `friend`.
The phrase's assigned emote is performed automatically.

## Managing Phrases and Categories

Open the phrase manager with `/rp config`.

- In **Phrases**, choose a category, search its phrases, and add, edit, or
  remove phrases. Select a personality, category, race, and optional class to
  manage that combination. Use **None** for race-wide phrases, and use the
  emote picker beside a phrase to change its emote.
- Longer phrases wrap in the list preview. When editing, use **Update** to save
  or **Cancel** to discard the edit.

## Profiles and Settings

In the **Settings** tab, choose English or Brazilian Portuguese, manage
profiles, and add, rename, delete, or choose an icon for categories.
Built-in categories cannot be deleted. Deleting a custom category also deletes
its phrases and requires confirmation. Profiles can be created, saved, loaded,
renamed, and deleted.
Deleting a profile requires confirmation; the Default profile cannot be deleted.
Each profile also has its own personalities, which are separate phrase
collections. Select a personality to switch collections, or enter a name and
choose **Create** to make a copy of the active personality. Personalities can
be renamed or deleted; the Default personality is protected.

## Resetting Saved Data

Click **Reset All Data** at the bottom of the phrase manager and confirm the
prompt to restore default phrases and settings. You can also open the
confirmation with:

```text
/rp reset
```

Use **Save & Reload** to reload the interface after making changes.

## Installation

Download or copy the `RandomDialogRP` folder into your World of Warcraft
installation's `Interface\AddOns\` directory, then enable **RandomDialogRP**
from the character selection AddOns menu. The exact game folder depends on
your installation.

releases.notes:
## 4.1.1 - 2026-11-26

### Changed

- Internal development improvements.

## 4.1.0 - 2026-11-26

### Added

- Added a profile-specific minimap button visibility setting and `/rp minimap`
  command to show the button again.
- Added quick-action tooltips with available phrase counts and a class/race
  breakdown.
- Added a No emote option for individual phrases and help for the `%s` target
  name placeholder.

### Changed

- Redesigned the tutorial with scrollable sections and examples, and made it
  reappear for major/minor releases and tutorial feature updates.
- Improved settings window layering, Escape behavior, and emote picker
  appearance and dismissal.
- Positioned the minimap button along the minimap's outer rim.

### Fixed

- Prevented renaming a category to its existing name from reporting a change
  or deleting a custom category.

## 4.0.0 - 2026-11-13

### Added

- Added a first-use tutorial explaining the phrase hierarchy and addon workflow,
  with a Tutorial button in Settings to reopen it.
- Added personality, category, race, and class selectors to phrase management.

### Changed

- Reorganized the manager into Phrases and Settings tabs, moving personality
  and category management into Settings alongside profiles and language.
- Refreshed the main and manager panels with an opaque, Leatrix Plus-inspired
  style and made Personality the first main-panel selector.
- Expanded phrase selection to favor class-specific phrases while retaining
  race-wide phrases for variety and when class phrases are unavailable.

## 4.0.0 - 2026-11-13

### Added

- Added a first-use tutorial explaining the phrase hierarchy and addon workflow,
  with a Tutorial button in Settings to reopen it.
- Added personality, category, race, and class selectors to phrase management.

### Changed

- Reorganized the manager into Phrases and Settings tabs, moving personality
  and category management into Settings alongside profiles and language.
- Refreshed the main and manager panels with an opaque, Leatrix Plus-inspired
  style and made Personality the first main-panel selector.
- Expanded phrase selection to favor class-specific phrases while retaining
  race-wide phrases for variety and when class phrases are unavailable.
